verdicts.name: GUO Charng Rang
verdicts.evidence: Read: https://api.openalex.org/authors?search=Charng%20Guo and search=Guo%20Charng-Rang -> a single author A5078242687 'Charng Rang Guo', 5 works, last institution Shandong University, ORCID 0009-0006-2797-7550. https://api.openalex.org/works?filter=author.id:A5078242687 -> works are number theory ('Joint cubic moment of Eisenstein series and Hecke-Maass cusp forms' 2025, Shandong University; 'On the Zeros of zeta(s)' 1995, Oxford; two 2026 papers, Shandong/none). None has an NUS affiliation and none is dated 2018-2021; this looks like a different (mathematician) person, with no NUS link. ORCID public search with a name query errored (HTTP 500 undefined field), so ORCID was not independently searched; the OpenAlex-listed ORCID has no NUS tie in what I read. DBLP search API (dblp.org/search/author/api) returned an Anubis 'Making sure you're not a bot' challenge; I did not bypass it, so the DBLP pids cited by the row (71/8334 etc.) were not re-read. No anchor clearly him with NUS-affiliated 2018-2021 papers found.
